title.description: Title shown in the frame chrome.

status.description: Connection status shown in the frame chrome.

error.description: Recovery error message. Shown with recovery UI when `status` is `error`.

columnWidth.description: Character-cell width, in pixels, used to compute `{ cols, rows }` on resize.

rowHeight.description: Character-cell height, in pixels, used to compute `{ cols, rows }` on resize.

class.description: Additional class merged with the component's root class.

unsupportedProps.name: onDimensionsChange
unsupportedProps.description: Called with `{ cols, rows }` whenever the character-cell size changes, so the host can resize its PTY.

unsupportedProps.name: onReloadRequest
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the user requests a reload from the recovery UI shown when `status` is `error`.
